# HisabIQ UI instruction for any AI

Read docs/ui/HISABIQ-DESIGN-GUIDE.md in full before designing or modifying UI. It is the consolidated v2.2 reference. Read AGENTS.md and the relevant current contract, then inspect the actual shared component and reference screen. GitHub shuvodelux-commits/hisabiq_ui is the implementation source of truth. In Magic Patterns, read the same guide under docs/ui/; the visual Brand Guide exposes the same chapters.

Compose HisabIQ's existing design. Dashboard supplies summary composition; Party Ledger supplies underline tabs and record workspaces; Products supplies table typography; POS V2 supplies product search, editable carts and transaction interaction. Use actual components, not copied lookalikes. The machine inventory docs/ui/design-system.json lists current files, exported primitives, colors and Lucide usages; it is an index, not proof that every legacy screen follows the rules.

Before JSX, map every element to its shared source. Ordinary buttons, inputs, filters, selects, dates, numeric/joined fields and standalone icon actions are 36px. Only explicitly designated major transaction review/completion actions use 48px with data-erp-workflow-action="complete". Page titles use PageHeader. All tables and responsive row views use 13px main data, 12px headings and 11px helper/badge roles. Use Geist and Hind Siliguri; proportional UI digits; right-align amounts/quantities. Use theme tokens in light/dark, including portals. Ordinary secondary buttons use the shared white/thin-border treatment in light mode.

Input and textarea values use the shared 13px / 20px regular 400 typography at every breakpoint, Ink 600 value text and muted regular placeholders. Keep labels separate; never inherit their medium weight into fields. Preserve 36px control geometry, numeric stepping and proportional digits. Calculator retains its own scale.

Actual content navigation uses Party-style text tabs with one 2px primary underline and the shared Framer Motion indicator. Payment/status/quantity choices are field choices, not navigation. Keep existing motion timings, reduced-motion behavior and focus. Use existing Lucide glyphs, labels and semantic colors. Use searchable entity/product selection, short fixed-list selects and inline + Add new inside the dropdown. Preserve and auto-select in the parent draft after Quick Add.

Provide all applicable states: default, hover, focus, selected, disabled/reason, read-only, loading, empty/no matches, error/retry and actual outcome. Support English + Bangla, English and Bangla through existing preferences/dictionaries; translate visible labels and accessible names, never stored IDs. Keep compact informative layouts with useful Bangla helpers, Advanced for uncommon fields, More for secondary actions and one clear primary task.

Stay inside the requested business context. Reuse the existing full editor and return path; keep period, filters, selection, scroll and draft. Payment, return, correction and stock rules remain domain-specific. Clearly label sample data and simulated UI-preview behavior. A success toast does not implement a real financial, SMS or stock operation.

If a needed component is absent, compose the nearest existing family first. Do not invent an exported Card, Drawer, ActionMenu or ProductPicker because a plan mentioned it. Propose the smallest shared extension, specify its states/keyboard/language/responsive rules and document the gap. Do not redesign unrelated modules or add another component/icon/motion library.

Verify the touched scope in light/dark, keyboard/touch, reduced motion where applicable, long English/Bangla, phone/tablet/desktop, dirty-draft handling and errors. Run guide sync --check and the relevant existing build/type/UI/browser checks. Report actual evidence and remaining gaps. When guide rules change, edit the canonical Markdown, regenerate the visual data/inventory and synchronize the same version to Magic Patterns.

Use the rendered visual component library and src/data/componentCatalog.json as the example index. Inspect the actual specimen and state coverage, not just the source-file inventory. For Party actions, the active relationship chooses the exact icon/action pair from partyRoleActions.ts; follow guide section 23. Add a working visual specimen for every new shared family, and label prepared future compositions honestly.
